newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH COAL PRICES NOT TO RISE - INDUSTRY MINISTRY.
newsitem.headline: POLISH COAL PRICES NOT TO RISE - INDUSTRY MINISTRY.

text.p: The 20-percent rise in Polish coal prices requested by coal firms earlier this week will not take effect, the industry ministry said in a statement late on Friday.
The statment said the decision was made after a meeting of officials from the industry and finance ministries and the cabinet and anti-monopoly offices.

"An agreement was reached providing the coal mining industry indispensable financial means for the restoration of partial financial liquidity to the end of 1996 without a change in coal prices for the power sector,"it said.
It gave no further details. No one at any of the ministries was available for comment.

On Tuesday the industry minister rejected Polish coal firms' request of a 20-percent rise from September 1, saying it would lift electrical energy prices and threaten inflation targets of 17 percent for this year.
